title: Seminyak vs Uluwatu: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Seminyak for walkability, dining, and beach clubs. Uluwatu for white-sand beaches, surf, and clifftop sunsets. Do both — they are under an hour apart.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Uluwatu wins easily — white sand, turquoise water, limestone cliffs. Seminyak has dark volcanic sand and beach clubs.

categories.name: Surfing
categories.summary: World-class breaks (Uluwatu, Padang Padang, Bingin). Seminyak beach surf is inconsistent.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Seminyak has Bali s best restaurant strip (Eat Street). Uluwatu has excellent clifftop dining but fewer choices.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Seminyak beach clubs and bars run until 3am nightly. Uluwatu s Single Fin Sunday is legendary but quiet on weeknights.

categories.name: Shopping
categories.summary: Seminyak has Bali s best boutiques and designer stores. Uluwatu has limited shopping.

categories.name: Walkability
categories.summary: Seminyak is highly walkable. Uluwatu requires scooter or driver for everything.

categories.name: Culture & Temples
categories.summary: Pura Luhur Uluwatu and the Kecak Fire Dance at sunset are unmissable Bali experiences.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Uluwatu edges cheaper — budget rooms from -40/night vs Seminyak s -70 minimum.

faq.question: Should I stay in Seminyak or Uluwatu?
faq.answer: Seminyak for walkability, shopping, and beach clubs. Uluwatu for beaches, surf, and dramatic clifftop scenery. Do both if possible.

faq.question: Is Seminyak or Uluwatu better for beaches?
faq.answer: Uluwatu by a wide margin — white sand, turquoise water, and stunning limestone cliffs.

faq.question: How far is Seminyak from Uluwatu?
faq.answer: About 22-26km, taking 45-60 minutes without traffic. Grab costs IDR 100,000-150,000 (-9).
